title: Native agent ecosystem
description: Native exported counters and local service health. Token panels are native-client telemetry, not estimates of savings. Cache/reasoning subsets must not be added again. Synthetic acceptance alerts are explicitly labeled. Raw prompt/tool bodies are omitted upstream by the collector.

panels.title: Codex turn tokens per minute — lower bound until step 7 read-back
panels.description: Lower bound until deployed created-timestamp-zero-ingestion and a newly born single-turn counter reconciliation pass. NativeStack2604 has no proposed anchored-query flag. Prometheus edge extrapolation can overcount; it does not prove complete first samples. Input/cache and output/reasoning subsets are not additive. Never add this total to Loki request usage.

panels.title: Claude tokens per minute
panels.description: Per-minute rate of the native cumulative counters by type. Keep input, output, cacheRead and cacheCreation distinct; these are not a measured savings percentage or an invoice. One series per writer: Claude sessions (session.id) and Codex processes (service.instance.id from the identity launcher) are summed at query time. Writers without an identity (instance="unscoped") are excluded; the integrity panel counts them.

panels.title: Service scrape health
Collector HTTP response status (200 expected)
panels.description: NativeStack2604's http_check/ecosystem receiver checks the Collector health endpoint on loopback port 21333. This panel reports that endpoint's HTTP status.

panels.title: Claude tokens (selected range)
panels.description: Prometheus increase over the selected range by type. One series per writer: Claude sessions (session.id) and Codex processes (service.instance.id from the identity launcher) are summed at query time. Writers without an identity (instance="unscoped") are excluded; the integrity panel counts them. increase() extrapolates at the range edges, a few percent high for short-lived writers; the exact difference is increase(...[$__range] anchored) on a Prometheus started with promql-extended-range-selectors. Loki keeps the per-request events.

panels.title: Token telemetry integrity (selected range)
panels.description: Resets: the most resets of any one Claude token or cost series. A resumed session resets each of its series once; many resets on one series mean several writers share it. Dropped delta points and unscoped writer series should be 0: delta_to_cumulative rejected Codex points (shared stream or stream limit), and counters without a per-process identity. See the native-telemetry-integrity alert rules.

targets.legendFormat: Most resets of one Claude series

panels.title: Tool, MCP, skill and subagent invoke rates (Loki)
Claude tool calls per minute by family
panels.description: Executed Claude Code tool calls (tool_result events) per minute. Families: shell = Bash/PowerShell, read = Read/Grep/Glob, edit = Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit, mcp = every MCP tool, skill = Skill, toolsearch = ToolSearch, web = WebFetch/WebSearch, agent = Agent/Task/Workflow, other = the rest. Includes subagents and workflow children. Names are Loki structured metadata written by the Collector's transform/tool_names; no label is added. Claude MCP server names and subagent types need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 in Claude Code; sessions started without it show an empty name (see the integrity panel). Agent types outside Claude Code's built-in agents show as custom. client is the Codex originator for codex-app-server front-ends, else the service name.

panels.title: Codex tool calls per minute by family
panels.description: Codex codex.tool_result events per minute, all front-ends and sub-agents. code_mode is the functions/exec and functions/wait wrapper: Codex also records every call made inside it, so do not add code_mode to the other families. mcp = tool_namespace mcp__<server>; agent = the collaboration namespace. Names are Loki structured metadata written by the Collector's transform/tool_names; no label is added. Claude MCP server names and subagent types need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 in Claude Code; sessions started without it show an empty name (see the integrity panel). Agent types outside Claude Code's built-in agents show as custom. client is the Codex originator for codex-app-server front-ends, else the service name.

panels.title: MCP calls per minute by client and server
panels.description: MCP tool results per minute by client and server. Claude names come from tool_parameters (OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1); Codex names come from its native mcp_server field. Every Codex app-server front-end reports service.name codex-app-server, so client uses the thread's originator there. One app-server process gives new threads the originator of the first client that initialized it. A series without a server name is a Claude session without tool details. Names are Loki structured metadata written by the Collector's transform/tool_names; no label is added. Claude MCP server names and subagent types need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 in Claude Code; sessions started without it show an empty name (see the integrity panel). Agent types outside Claude Code's built-in agents show as custom. client is the Codex originator for codex-app-server front-ends, else the service name.

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (client, mcp_server_name) (rate({service_name=~".+"} | event_name=~"tool_result|codex.tool_result" | tool_family="mcp" | keep client, mcp_server_name [$__auto]))

panels.title: Skill activations per minute by name
panels.description: Claude Code skill_activated events: model-invoked (claude-proactive, nested-skill) and /skill (user-slash). User-defined skills are named custom_skill unless OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1. Codex loads skills as instructions and emits no skill event. Names are Loki structured metadata written by the Collector's transform/tool_names; no label is added. Claude MCP server names and subagent types need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 in Claude Code; sessions started without it show an empty name (see the integrity panel). Agent types outside Claude Code's built-in agents show as custom. client is the Codex originator for codex-app-server front-ends, else the service name.

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (skill_name, invocation_trigger) (rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="skill_activated" | keep skill_name, invocation_trigger [$__auto]))

panels.title: Subagent and workflow launches per minute
panels.description: Launches, counted when they start. Claude: accepted tool_decision events for Agent/Task (by subagent_type) and Workflow, which Claude Code logs before the tool runs; an Agent call's tool_result arrives only when its subagent finishes, and a rejected call never launches. Codex: spawn messages (codex.agent_communication kind=spawn, state=send), which carry no originator, so app-server front-ends share one series; sender and receiver thread ids stay as structured metadata for drill-down. Names are Loki structured metadata written by the Collector's transform/tool_names; no label is added. Claude MCP server names and subagent types need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 in Claude Code; sessions started without it show an empty name (see the integrity panel). Agent types outside Claude Code's built-in agents show as custom. client is the Codex originator for codex-app-server front-ends, else the service name.

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (subagent_type) (rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_decision" | decision="accept" | tool_name=~"Agent|Task" | keep subagent_type [$__auto]))
60 * sum by (service_name) (rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_decision" | decision="accept" | tool_name="Workflow" | keep service_name [$__auto]))
60 * sum by (service_name) (rate({service_name=~".+"} | event_name="codex.agent_communication" | kind="spawn" | state="send" | keep service_name [$__auto]))

panels.title: Tool calls per minute by client and actor
panels.description: By client (the Codex originator for codex-app-server front-ends, else the service name). Codex: actor main (agent_name /root) or subagent (/root/<task>); the agent path itself is not exported. Claude: workflow children carry workflow.run_id (actor workflow); Agent-tool subagents are not marked on tool events, so their calls fall in main_or_subagent. The second query adds Claude's own per-subagent total_tool_uses, reported when a subagent completes: a lagged subset of main_or_subagent, never an addition to it. Its rate sums each interval's completion totals and divides by the interval length (Loki's unwrapped rate, not rate_counter); it is never a difference between completions, so one completion is one useful sample where it lands. Names are Loki structured metadata written by the Collector's transform/tool_names; no label is added. Claude MCP server names and subagent types need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 in Claude Code; sessions started without it show an empty name (see the integrity panel). Agent types outside Claude Code's built-in agents show as custom. client is the Codex originator for codex-app-server front-ends, else the service name.

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (client, actor) (rate({service_name=~".+"} | event_name=~"tool_result|codex.tool_result" | tool_family!="code_mode" | keep client, actor [$__auto]))
60 * sum by (agent_type) (rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="subagent_completed" | keep agent_type, total_tool_uses | unwrap total_tool_uses | __error__="" [$__auto]))
targets.legendFormat: Claude subagent {{agent_type}} · tool uses at completion

panels.title: MCP share of tool calls (selected range)
panels.description: MCP tool results over all tool results in the selected range. Codex code-mode wrappers are excluded from the denominator because the calls inside them are counted.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_family="mcp" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_result" | keep service_name [$__auto]))

(sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | tool_family="mcp" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | tool_family!="code_mode" | keep service_name [$__auto]))

panels.title: ctx and rtk adoption (selected range)
panels.description: ctx: context-mode MCP calls over context-mode + shell + read + web calls. rtk: shell calls whose command starts with rtk over shell calls with a known command start (shell_rtk is computed in the Collector from Claude's bash_command or Codex's exec_command cmd; the command text itself is deleted).

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_result" | mcp_server_name=~"context-mode|plugin_context-mode_context-mode" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_family=~"shell|read|web" or mcp_server_name=~"context-mode|plugin_context-mode_context-mode" | keep service_name [$__auto]))

(sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | mcp_server_name=~"context-mode|plugin_context-mode_context-mode" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | tool_family=~"shell|read|web" or mcp_server_name=~"context-mode|plugin_context-mode_context-mode" | keep service_name [$__auto]))

(sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_result" | shell_rtk="true" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_result" | shell_rtk!="" | keep service_name [$__auto]))

(sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | shell_rtk="true" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | shell_rtk!="" | keep service_name [$__auto]))

panels.title: Invoke-rate telemetry integrity (selected range)
panels.description: All three should be 0. MCP calls without a server name come from Claude sessions started without OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1. Unparsed: tool_parameters that were not a JSON object (names lost, content still deleted). Replaced names failed the Collector's name pattern (for example text with spaces) and are exported as other. Agent types outside Claude Code's built-in agents are custom by design and are not counted here.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_family="mcp" | mcp_server_name="" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)
targets.legendFormat: Claude MCP calls without a server name

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | tool_details="unparsed" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | mcp_server_name="other" or mcp_tool_name="other" or skill_name="other" or originator="other" or client="other" | keep service_name [$__auto])) or vector(0)
targets.legendFormat: Names replaced by the name pattern

panels.title: MCP-consuming API requests per minute by actor
panels.description: Claude api_request events that consumed an MCP tool result, by the requesting actor (query_source: main, subagent, workflow, auxiliary) and server. This is the only per-call link between an Agent-tool subagent and its MCP calls. It counts requests: several MCP results consumed by one request count once, so as a count of MCP calls it is a lower bound. Names are Loki structured metadata written by the Collector's transform/tool_names; no label is added. Claude MCP server names and subagent types need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 in Claude Code; sessions started without it show an empty name (see the integrity panel). Agent types outside Claude Code's built-in agents show as custom. client is the Codex originator for codex-app-server front-ends, else the service name.

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (actor, mcp_server_name) (rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | mcp_server_name!="" | keep actor, mcp_server_name [$__auto]))

panels.title: Codex lanes
Codex turns per minute by lane
panels.description: Completed Codex turns per minute by lane, from the native turn timer codex.turn.e2e_duration_ms, which records each turn when it ends (openai/codex rust-v0.160.0, codex-rs/core/src/tasks/mod.rs:404-406). codex.conversation.turn.count is not used: Codex records it once, at session shutdown. ecosystem_lane is the lane name that a lane's launch exports in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES (ecosystem.lane=<lane>); the Collector keeps it and makes it a label. unattributed is a Codex process started without it. Writers without a launcher identity (instance="unscoped") are included: a shared Codex delta stream undercounts, it does not inflate. Turns show activity, not outcomes; the lane board counts outcomes.

panels.title: Codex tool-call failure share by lane (1 h)
panels.description: Share of Codex tool calls (codex.tool.call) that failed (success="false") over the trailing hour, by lane. The red line is the CodexLaneToolErrorBurst threshold: the alert fires when more than 10% of at least 30 calls fail in the hour, for 15 minutes. A lane without failures shows 0.

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (ecosystem_lane) (increase(codex_tool_call_total{success="false"}[1h])) or 0 * sum by (ecosystem_lane) (increase(codex_tool_call_total[1h]))) / sum by (ecosystem_lane) (increase(codex_tool_call_total[1h])), "ecosystem_lane", "unattributed", "ecosystem_lane", "")

panels.title: Codex MCP error share by lane (1 h)
panels.description: Share of Codex MCP calls that returned an error (codex.mcp.call.error over codex.mcp.call) over the trailing hour, by lane. The red line is the CodexLaneMcpErrorRatio threshold: the alert fires when more than 10% of at least 20 calls fail in the hour, for 15 minutes. A lane without errors shows 0. The series also carry a tool label naming the MCP tool.

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (ecosystem_lane) (increase(codex_mcp_call_error_total[1h])) or 0 * sum by (ecosystem_lane) (increase(codex_mcp_call_total[1h]))) / sum by (ecosystem_lane) (increase(codex_mcp_call_total[1h])), "ecosystem_lane", "unattributed", "ecosystem_lane", "")

panels.title: Codex goal blocked and usage-limited events by lane (15 min)
panels.description: Goal events over the trailing 15 minutes, the windows of the CodexLaneGoalBlocked (warning) and CodexLaneUsageLimited (critical) alerts. These counters reach Prometheus as delta points, and their series leave the Collector's exporter 5 minutes after the last export, so a line shows for about 15 minutes after an event and then ends; the alerts keep firing 30 minutes longer. increase() extrapolates, so one event can read slightly above 1. The lane board shows the current goal state.

panels.title: Codex compactions by lane (4 h)
panels.description: Context compactions (codex.task.compact) over the trailing 4 hours, by lane. The counter also counts the compactions of in-process child threads, so it reads higher than the lane board's parent-thread count and is not compared with that count's WARN threshold (6 or more in 4 hours).
